description: Fetch one public Product Hunt product detail by its slug. Returns compact identity, description, categories, website, and review/follower stats by default; pass --detailed true for publication metadata, images, makers, the latest launch, and awards. Product Hunt login is not required.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Required Product Hunt product slug from search or a product-list command, for example linear or jupitrr.

parameters.name: detailed
parameters.description: Return publication metadata, images, makers, latest launch, and awards in addition to the compact product record. Pass true or false.
